resource: Live item handles of one GameSession that selected capability 14 CONTAINER_TREE_V1
allocation_impact: Measured as ITEMV0-RL-03 (315) plus, for each of the 16 views (BAGS0-RL-03), its container, which may be visible in no other view, and its 20 entries: 315 + 16 x 21 = 651, above the BAGS-0 floor of 382. The handle table of a capability 14 session is bounded by this value before inserting; a session without capability 14 keeps ITEMV0-RL-03.
boundary_tests: max=651: the views at their bounds hold 651 live handles
max+1=652: the table refuses a handle beyond the views' bounds
notes: BAGS-0 §5 and §10 (ITEMV0-RL-03 re-measured; sessions without capability 14 keep that base bound). Tests: container_tree::tests::live_handle_bound_adds_16_views_of_21_items, container_view::tests. Registered by OTV2-20261003-bags-wire-1.
